# Blewett

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P13](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P15](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0015)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Peter Blewett](../character/peter-blewett.md) (spouse)

## Appearance

Mrs. [Peter Blewett](../character/peter-blewett.md) is a small, sharp-faced woman with a shrewish appearance and sharp eyes. She is exceptionally thin, lacking an ounce of superfluous flesh on her bones.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P10](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0010), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P13](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0013)_

## Personality

Blewett is known for her stinginess. Discharged servant girls have shared fearsome tales regarding her severe temper.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P10](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0010)_

## Traits

- presumed stingy  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P10](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0010)</sub>

## History

Herb Blewett lived a long life, which he attributed to smoking tobacco to kill germs. On a Wednesday, he fell off a hayloft and rolled down a turnip chute into a box stall, landing directly under the heels of a wild, cross horse.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Change P37](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0037), [v3 ch.Summons P43](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0043)_
